title: Open channel: section hydraulics and flow regime
description: Reusable SVG rectangular open-channel component for continuity, hydraulic radius, Froude number, specific energy, and a Manning-capacity comparison at a specified depth.
learningObjectives: Compute section velocity and hydraulic radius for a rectangular channel.
Classify subcritical, near-critical, or supercritical flow using the Froude number while distinguishing a specified depth from a solved normal depth.

verification.notes: Equations and representative reference calculations were reviewed from source. Interactive browser and assistive-technology review remain pending.
